blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: . Current large video-language models (LVLMs) still face challenges when dealing with long videos, mainly because frames are often processed independently, making it difficult to capture temporal dependencies across events. Although retrieval-augmented approaches have been introduced to provide additional context, most of them operate at the frame or snippet level, which limits their ability to model how events evolve over time and relate to each other. In this paper, we propose Event Chain Retrieval-Augmented Generation (EC-RAG), a training-free framework that organizes video content into an explicit event chain before question answering. Instead of retrieving isolated frames or text segments, EC-RAG first partitions the video into semantically coherent segments, represents each segment using multi-modal signals, and then links them into a structured chain that preserves temporal order and captures inter-event relationships. Given a query, the system identifies relevant events within this chain and gathers supporting evidence from the associated modalities. Our approach offers several practical advantages: (i) event-level abstraction that better reflects how video content is naturally structured, enabling more reliable localization compared to frame-level retrieval; (ii) structured multi-modal fusion that aggregates speech, text, and visual cues at the event level, allowing complementary information to be more effectively utilized during reasoning; and (iii) plug-and-play compatibility with existing LVLM backbones, requiring no additional training or reliance on proprietary models. Experiments on Video-MME, MLVU, and LongVideoBench show that this event-centric design consistently outperforms frame-level retrieval baselines, highlighting the importance of modeling temporal structure for long-video understanding.
blocks.zh: 。 。 。 。 当前的大型视频语言模型(LVLMs)在处理长视频时仍然面临挑战,这主要是因为帧常常是独立处理的,因此很难捕捉到跨事件的时间依赖性. 虽然采用了可检索的方法来提供额外的上下文,但大多数方法都运行在框架或片段层面,这限制了它们模拟事件如何随时间演变和相互关联的能力. 在本文中,我们提出事件链检索增强生成(EC-RAG),这是在回答问题之前将视频内容组织成明确事件链的无培训框架. EC-RAG没有检索到孤立的帧或文本片段,而是首先将视频分解成集成相通的片段,使用多模式信号代表每个片段,再将它们链接到一个结构化的链条中,保持时间顺序并捕捉事件间的关系. 考虑到一个查询,该系统确定这一链条内的相关活动,并从相关模式收集佐证证据。 我们的方法提供了几个实际的优点:(一)事件层次抽象,更好地反映视频内容如何自然结构化,使得比帧层次检索更可靠地本地化;(二)结构化多式聚变,将语音,文字,和视觉提示在事件层次集中起来,使辅助信息在推理过程中得到更有效的利用;(三)与现有的LVLM主干网兼容,不需要额外的培训或依赖专有模式. 关于Video-MME,MLVU,和LongVideo Bench的实验表明,这种以事件为中心的设计一贯优于帧级回取基线,突出了模拟时间结构对长视频理解的重要性.

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 导言

blocks.en: With the rapid advancement of Large Video-Language Models (LVLMs), significant progress has been made in video understanding tasks ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2024a ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2024c ; Lin et al., 2024b ) . However, when processing long videos spanning tens of minutes to hours, current LVLMs face critical challenges: the limited context window restricts the number of frames that can be processed, while simply increasing sampled frames leads to information redundancy and reasoning degradation.
blocks.zh: 随着大型视频语言模型(LVLMs)的迅速发展,视频理解任务取得了重大进展(Liu等,2023;Chen等,2024a; 刘等,2026;张等,2023;张等,2024c;林等,2024b. 然而,当处理长达数十分钟到小时的长相视频时,当前LVLM面临严峻的挑战:上下文窗口有限,限制了可以处理的帧数量,而仅仅增加取样帧会导致信息冗余和推理退化.

blocks.en: Recent studies have sought to extend the context length of LVLMs for long video understanding, such as LongLLaVA ( Song et al., 2024 ) scales token capacity to ingest more frames. However, this brute-force expansion proves brittle—Video-MME ( Fu et al., 2025 ) benchmark shows accuracy drops when additional frames are supplied beyond a threshold. This outcome suggests that simply increasing the number of sampled frames not only leads to information redundancy but also imposes additional challenges for the model to handle complex reasoning.
blocks.zh: 最近的研究试图将LVLMs的上下文长度以进行长视频理解,例如LongLLAVA(Song等,2024年)缩放符号容量来摄取更多的帧. 然而,这种野蛮势力扩张证明,当额外框架供应超过阈值时,Brittle-Video-MME(Fu等,2025年)基准的准确性会下降。 这一结果表明,仅仅增加抽样框架的数量不仅会导致信息冗余,而且给模型处理复杂推理带来了更多的挑战.

blocks.en: Figure 1. Advantages of our EC-RAG. EC-RAG provides an event-centric, training-free pipeline with structured temporal understanding that is easily compatible with any LVLM.
blocks.zh: 图 1. 欧共体区域专家组的优势。 EC-RAG提供以事件为中心、无培训的管道,具有结构化的时间理解,容易与任何LVLM相容。

blocks.en: A parallel research direction employs Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to supplement video queries with externally retrieved information. Early efforts in this direction ( Liu et al., 2024a ; Zhang et al., 2024d ) demonstrate that augmenting visual inputs with auxiliary textual information can effectively enhance video understanding, particularly for content that is difficult to capture through visual frames alone. These methods typically extract three types of auxiliary texts from videos: automatic speech recognition (ASR) for transcribing spoken dialogue and narration, optical character recognition (OCR) for capturing on-screen text such as titles and labels, and object detection (DET) for identifying visual entities and their spatial arrangements. Building upon this foundation, Video-RAG ( Luo et al., 2024 ) proposes visually-aligned auxiliary texts from OCR, ASR, and DET, achieving notable improvements with minimal computational overhead. TV-RAG ( Cao et al., 2025 ) further introduces temporal-window retrieval with entropy-based keyframe selection to handle semantic drift in long videos. More recently, AdaVideoRAG ( Xue et al., 2025 ) employs adaptive difficulty routing and graph databases for complex multi-hop reasoning. Despite these advances, existing video RAG methods share a fundamental limitation: they retrieve at the frame level or text segment level, treating video as a collection of independent units rather than a coherent narrative of interconnected events. Long videos inherently contain sequences of causally connected events—a lecture progresses through topics, a movie unfolds through scenes, a cooking video follows recipe steps. Without modeling this event structure, current methods produce fragmented retrieval results that fail to support questions requiring temporal reasoning.
blocks.zh: 一个平行的研究方向是利用检索增强生成(RAG),用外部检索的信息补充视频查询。 这方面的早期努力(刘等,2024a; Zhang等,2024d.)证明用辅助文字信息来增强视觉输入可以有效增强视频理解,尤其是对于仅通过视觉帧难以捕捉的内容而言. 这些方法一般从视频中取出三类辅助文本:自动语音识别(ASR)用于转录口语对话和叙事,光学字符识别(OCR)用于捕获屏幕文本,如标题和标签等,以及用于识别视觉实体及其空间安排的物体检测(DET). 在这个基础上,Video-RAG(Luo等,2024年)提出了OCR、ASR和DET的视觉相通辅助文本,取得了显著的改进,计算间接费用最低。 TV-RAG(Cao等,2025年)进一步引入了时间-窗口取回,并采用以肽为基础的键框选择,以处理长视频中的语义漂移. 最近,AdaVideoRAG(薛等,2025年)利用适应性困难的路由和图表数据库进行复杂的多跳推理。 尽管取得了这些进步,但现有的视频RAG方法有着基本的局限性:它们取回了帧层或文本段层,将视频视为独立单位的集合,而不是互相关联事件的连贯叙事. 长相影片内在包含一系列因果相通的事件, 如果不模拟这种事件结构,目前的方法会产生零碎的检索结果,不能支持需要时间推理的问题.

blocks.en: Based on this observation, we focus on the following question: Can we design a video RAG framework that explicitly captures temporal event dynamics and inter-event relationships for coherent long video understanding?
blocks.zh: 基于这一看法,我们侧重于以下问题: 我们能否设计一个视频RAG框架,明确记录时间事件动态和事件间关系,以便一致的长视频理解?

blocks.en: To this end, we propose Event Chain Retrieval-Augmented Generation (EC-RAG), a training-free framework that organizes video content into explicit event chains before question answering. Instead of retrieving isolated frames or text snippets, EC-RAG first partitions the video into semantically coherent temporal segments, aggregates multi-modal signals (ASR, OCR, DET) within each segment to form events, and links them into a structured chain that preserves temporal order. For multi-modal extraction, we introduce CLIP-Variance guided keyframe selection that combines query-semantic relevance with visual informativeness, ensuring selected frames are both relevant and information-rich. Given a user query, EC-RAG performs event-level localization to identify the most relevant events along with their temporal context, and gathers supporting evidence from associated modalities for answer generation.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们提出事件链检索增强生成(EC-RAG),这是一个在回答问题之前将视频内容组织成明确事件链的无培训框架。 EC-RAG没有检索到被隔离的帧或文本片段,而是首先将视频分解成凝聚相通的时间段,将多模式信号(ASR,OCR,DET)集成到每个片段内形成事件,并将它们链接到一个结构化的链条中来维护时间顺序. 对于多模式提取,我们采用CLIP-Variance引导键框选择,将查询-语义相关性与视觉信息性相结合,确保所选框既相关又丰富信息. 考虑到用户查询,EC-RAG进行事件级本地化,以确定最相关的事件及其时间背景,并从相关模式收集支持证据生成答案。

blocks.en: We evaluate EC-RAG on Video-MME ( Fu et al., 2025 ) , MLVU ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) , and LongVideoBench ( Wu et al., 2024 ) benchmarks. By applying EC-RAG to five different open-source LVLMs, we achieve an average performance improvement of 4% on Video-MME. Furthermore, compared with existing frame-level retrieval methods such as Video-RAG and TV-RAG, EC-RAG consistently demonstrates superior performance, validating the effectiveness of our event-chain-based approach. Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We propose EC-RAG, a novel framework that explicitly models temporal event chains for long video understanding. Unlike existing methods operating at frame or snippet level, EC-RAG captures inter-event relationships and enables coherent reasoning over extended temporal spans. • We introduce CLIP-Variance guided keyframe selection that jointly considers semantic relevance and visual informativeness, improving the quality of multi-modal information extraction for event construction. • We design a query-guided event localization mechanism that identifies relevant events within the temporal chain and aggregates multi-modal evidence, providing structured context for LVLM answer generation.
blocks.zh: 我们评价EC-RAG关于视频-MME(Fu等,2025年),MLVU(周等,2024年),和LongVideo Bench(Wu等,2024年)的基准. 通过将EC-RAG应用到五个不同的开源LVLM,我们实现了视频-MME上的平均性能提升4%. 此外,与Video-RAG和TV-RAG等现有帧级检索方法相比,EC-RAG始终表现出优异的表现,证明了我们基于事件链的方法的有效性。 • 我们的贡献概述如下: 我们提出EC-RAG,这是一个新颖的框架,明确模拟时间事件链,以便长视频了解。 与在框架或片段一级操作的现有方法不同,EC-RAG捕捉事件间的关系,并能够在较长的时间段上进行连贯的推理。 我们采用CLIP-Variance制导的关键框架选择,共同考虑语义相关性和视觉信息,提高活动构建的多模式信息提取质量。 我们设计了一个查询指导事件本地化机制,确定时间链内的相关活动,并汇总多模式证据,为LVLM答题生成提供结构化上下文.

blocks.en: 2. Related Work
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1. Video Understanding with Large Language Models
blocks.zh: 2.1. 与大语言模型的视频理解

blocks.en: The emergence of powerful LLMs has spurred efforts to develop comprehensive video-language systems. Early works like Video-ChatGPT ( Maaz et al., 2024 ) and VideoChat ( Li et al., 2025 ) adopt frame-wise feature extraction followed by temporal aggregation. Video-LLaVA ( Lin et al., 2024a ) introduces a unified projection to bridge visual and textual modalities, while LLaVA-NeXT-Video ( Zhang et al., 2024d ) further refines this through video-specific adaptation. These models perform well on short videos but struggle with longer content due to frame sampling constraints.
blocks.zh: 强大的LLMS的出现推动了开发综合视频语言系统的努力. 早期作品有"Video-ChatGPT"(Maaz等,2024年)和"Video"等. Chat(Li等,2025年)采用帧式特征提取后再进行时间聚合. 视频LLAVA (Lin等,2024a.)引入了统一投影以桥接视觉和文字模式,而LLaVA-NEXT-Video(Zhang等,2024d.)则通过视频特异性改编来进一步完善了这一点. 这些模型在短片上表现良好,但由于帧采样的限制,其内容却与更长.

blocks.en: To address this limitation, recent methods explore expanding the context window for extended sequences. LongVA ( Zhang et al., 2024b ) and Long-LLaVA ( Song et al., 2024 ) leverage pre-training on lengthy documents to develop transferable sequence modeling capabilities. INTP ( Shang et al., 2024 ) reorganizes visual tokens to accommodate more information within fixed context limits. However, densely sampling frames quickly becomes computationally prohibitive, and the high redundancy in video data often limits the benefits of processing more frames.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这一局限性,最近的方法探索扩展序列的上下文窗口. LongVA(张等,2024年b)和Long-LLAVA (Song等, 2024) 利用长文件的预训,来开发可转移序列建模能力. INTP(Shang等,2024年)重组了视觉符号,以在固定上下文限制范围内容纳更多信息. 然而,密集的采样帧很快就变得在计算上令人无法接受,而视频数据的高度冗余往往限制了处理更多帧的好处.

blocks.en: 2.2. LLM-based Agents for Video Understanding
blocks.zh: 2.2. 基于LLM的视频理解代理商

blocks.en: An alternative paradigm employs LLMs as controllers to orchestrate specialized tools for video comprehension ( Gupta and Kembhavi, 2023 ; Min et al., 2024 ; Surís et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024a ) . Representative methods such as VideoAgent ( Fan et al., 2024 ) and MM-VID ( Lin et al., 2023 ) enable dynamic interaction with video content through iterative retrieval and reasoning. While flexible, these approaches introduce substantial latency from multiple tool calls and often rely on proprietary APIs, limiting broader adoption in open-source settings.
blocks.zh: 另一种范式是使用LLMs作为控制器来协调专门的视频理解工具(Gupta和Kembhavi,2023;Min等人,2024;Surís等人,2023;Wang等人,2024;Zhang等人,2024a)。 VideoAgent(Fan等,2024年)和MM-VID(Lin等,2023年)等代表方法通过迭代检索和推理,能与视频内容进行动态互动. 这些方法虽然具有灵活性,但从多个工具调用中引入了实质性的耐用性,并经常依赖专有性API,限制了在开源环境下更广泛的采用.

blocks.en: 2.3. Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Video
blocks.zh: 2.3. 视频检索-增强生成

blocks.en: RAG-based methods retrieve relevant information from pre-constructed databases to augment video understanding. Video-RAG ( Luo et al., 2024 ) extracts multimodal cues including speech transcripts and detected objects to build searchable knowledge bases. TV-RAG ( Cao et al., 2025 ) enhances this with temporal-aware retrieval, while AdaVideoRAG ( Xue et al., 2025 ) employs adaptive routing for queries of varying complexity. Current approaches, however, retrieve content at the frame or segment granularity without capturing the temporal progression of events, limiting performance on questions requiring understanding of how actions unfold across time.
blocks.zh: 基于RAG的方法从预先构建的数据库取回相关信息来增强视频理解. 视频RAG (Luo等,2024年)取出多模式提示,包括语音记录和被探测到的物体来建立可搜索的知识库. TV-RAG(Cao等人,2025年)通过时间认识检索加强了这一功能,而AdaVideoRAG(Xue等人,2025年)则采用适应性路线处理各种复杂问题。 然而,目前的做法是在没有记录事件时间进展的情况下检索框架或分块颗粒性的内容,从而限制在需要了解行动如何进行的问题上的绩效。

blocks.en: Figure 2. Overview of the EC-RAG framework. The pipeline comprises four stages: (i) Query Decoupling parses the user question into modality-specific retrieval requests for ASR, OCR, and DET; (ii) CLIP-Variance Guided Multimodal Extraction selects informative keyframes through weighted scoring of visual similarity and frame variance, then extracts speech transcripts, on-screen text, and scene graphs via open-vocabulary object detection; (iii) Temporal Event Chain Construction segments the video into 30-second units and builds a chain of semantically coherent events, where each event integrates its associated multimodal evidence with explicit temporal relations; (iv) Evidence-augmented Multimodal Reasoning performs query-guided event localization to retrieve relevant events, then feeds the event chain summary, located events, and raw evidence to the LVLM for answer generation. By organizing video content as structured event sequences, EC-RAG captures temporal dynamics and inter-event dependencies for complex video understanding.
blocks.zh: 图 2. 欧共体区域专家组框架概述。 管道包括四个阶段:(一) 查询解析用户问题,将用户问题分为ASR、OCR和DET特定模式检索请求;(二) CLIP-Variance Guided Multimodule Integration通过视觉相似度和帧差异加权评分选择信息性关键框架,然后通过开放式伏尔加对象检测提取语音记录、屏幕文本和场景图;(三) 临时事件链构建将视频分解为30秒单元,并构建一个集成一致事件的链条,其中每个事件将相关的多模式证据与明确的时间关系相融合;(四) 证据强化多模式理性进行查询引导事件本地化,以检索相关活动,然后将事件链摘要、位置事件和原始证据输入LVLM生成。 通过组织视频内容作为结构化的事件序列,EC-RAG捕捉时间动态和事件间依赖性,以进行复杂的视频理解.

blocks.en: 3. Method
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: We propose EC-RAG , a training-free retrieval-augmented framework for large video-language models that organizes video content as structured event chains. As illustrated in Figure 2 , our pipeline comprises four stages: (i) Query Decoupling : The user query is decomposed into modality-specific retrieval requests for ASR, OCR, and DET. (ii) CLIP-Variance Guided Multimodal Extraction : Informative keyframes are selected through joint CLIP similarity and variance weighting, followed by parallel extraction of speech, text, and object information. (iii) Temporal Event Chain Construction : The video is segmented into temporal units and organized as a chain of semantically coherent events with explicit inter-event relations. (iv) Evidence-augmented Multimodal Reasoning : Query-guided localization identifies relevant events, and the LVLM generates answers grounded in the event chain context and multimodal evidence.
blocks.zh: 我们提出EC-RAG,这是大型视频语言模型的免费培训检索强化框架,将视频内容组织成结构化的活动链。 如图2所示,我们的管道包括四个阶段:(一) 查询脱钩: 用户查询被分解成特定模式的ASR,OCR,和DET检索请求. (二) CLIP-Variance Guided Multimodule Integration :通过联合CLIP的相似性和相差分量来选择信息密钥框架,然后平行取出语音,文本和对象信息. (三) 临时事件链建设: 视频被分解成时间单元,组织成一系列具有明确事件间关系的精密连贯的事件. (四)证据强化多式联运理由:查询指导本地化确定相关事件,LVLM生成基于事件链上下文和多式联运证据的答案.

blocks.en: Problem Formulation. Given a video V V and a user query Q Q , a frame sampler extracts N N frames 𝐅 = { F 1 , F 2 , … , F N } \mathbf{F}=\{F_{1},F_{2},\ldots,F_{N}\} . These frames are encoded by a visual encoder (e.g., CLIP-L ( Radford et al., 2021 ) ) to obtain visual features 𝐅 v \mathbf{F}_{v} . The standard LVLM inference can be formulated as: (1) O = LVLM ​ ( 𝐅 v , Q ) O=\text{LVLM}(\mathbf{F}_{v},Q) However, this direct approach struggles with long videos where critical information may be sparse across extended durations. EC-RAG addresses this limitation by constructing an event chain (EC) ℰ \mathcal{E} that captures the temporal structure of video content, and performing query-guided event localization to retrieve relevant context before final reasoning: (2) O = LVLM ​ ( 𝐅 v , Q , ℰ , 𝐀 ) O=\text{LVLM}(\mathbf{F}_{v},Q,\mathcal{E},\mathbf{A}) where ℰ \mathcal{E} denotes the temporal event chain and 𝐀 \mathbf{A} represents the retrieved multimodal evidence. This formulation enables the model to reason over both visual frames and structured textual context derived from the video.
blocks.zh: 问题表述。 由于视频V和用户查询QQ,帧采样器提取出N N帧F={F 1,F 2,.,F N}\mathbf{F}=\{1},F_{2},\ldots,F_{N}\}. 这些帧由视觉编码器(如CLIP-L(Radford等,2021年))编码以获得视觉特性F v\mathbf{F}_{v}. 标准LVLM推论可被表述为:(1) O = LVLM (F v, Q ) O=\text{LVLM} (\mathbf{F}_{v}, Q ) 然而,这种直接的方法与长视频相冲突,其中关键信息可能在很长的时间内稀少. EC-RAG通过构建一个事件链(EC)\mathcal{E}来应对这一限制,它能够捕捉视频内容的时间结构,并且执行由查询引导的事件本地化,在最后推理之前检索相关上下文: (2)O = LVLM(F v, Q, E, A) O=\text{LVLM} (\mathbf{F}_{v}, Q,\mathcal{E},\mathbf{A},其中E\mathcal{E}表示时间事件链和A\mathbf{A}代表被取回的多模式证据. 这种配制使模型能够通过视觉框架和从视频中得出的结构化文字背景来进行推理.

blocks.en: 3.1. Query Decoupling
blocks.zh: 3.1. 查询脱钩

blocks.en: Before processing the video content, we first analyze the user query to understand what types of information are needed to answer it. Motivated by recent methods ( Lin et al., 2024a ; Luo et al., 2024 ) , this query decoupling step separates the retrieval planning from the actual video processing, allowing the system to focus computational resources on relevant modalities. Upon receiving a user query, EC-RAG decouples it into structured retrieval requests without accessing video frames. The LVLM analyzes the query to determine what information sources are needed: (3) 𝐑 = LVLM ​ ( P d , Q ) = { R asr , R ocr , R det } \mathbf{R}=\text{LVLM}(P_{d},Q)=\{R_{\text{asr}},R_{\text{ocr}},R_{\text{det}}\} where P d P_{d} is the decoupling prompt enhanced with few-shot examples that demonstrate how to extract retrieval targets from various question types. Each request may be NULL if the corresponding modality is unnecessary for the given query. Specifically, R asr R_{\text{asr}} specifies key phrases to retrieve from speech transcripts, which is particularly useful for questions about dialogue content or narration. R ocr R_{\text{ocr}} defines keywords to search in on-screen text, targeting questions about titles, labels, or displayed information. R det R_{\text{det}} indicates physical objects to detect in video frames, essential for visual grounding questions.
blocks.zh: 在处理视频内容之前,我们首先分析用户查询,以了解需要何种信息来回答. 受近代方法(Lin等,2024a;Luo等,2024)的推动,本查询解码步骤将检索规划与实际视频处理区分开来,使系统能够将计算资源集中在相关模式上. EC-RAG在收到用户查询后,将其解码为结构化检索请求而无需访问视频帧. LVLM分析查询以确定需要哪些信息来源: (3) R = LVLM (P d, Q) = { R asr, R ocr, R det}\ mathbf{R}=\text{LVLM} (P_{d}, Q)\R_{\text{asr}},R_{\text{ocr}},R_{\text{det}}\}} 在其中,Pd P_{d}是解对接的快取增强,其中少有射出的例子,说明如何从各种问题类型中提取取回目标. 如果给定的查询不需要相应的模式,每个请求都可能是NULL. 具体来说,Rasr R_{\text{asr}}}指定关键词句从语音记录稿中取出,这对对话内容或叙述的问题特别有用. R ocr R_{\text{ocr} 定义关键词, 用于在屏幕文本中搜索, 瞄准关于标题、 标签或显示信息的问题 。 R det RQQText{det} 表示在视频帧中检测的物理物体, 这对于视觉地面问题至关重要 。

blocks.en: The decoupling prompt guides the LVLM to identify concrete retrieval targets through structured examples. For detection requests, we enforce that R det R_{\text{det}} contains only physical entities rather than abstract concepts, ensuring compatibility with vision-based detection models. This constraint prevents the system from attempting to detect non-visual concepts like emotions or intentions.
blocks.zh: 脱钩即时引导LVLM通过结构化实例确定具体的检索目标. 对于检测请求,我们强制要求R det RQQtext{det}只包含物理实体,而不是抽象的概念,确保与基于视觉的检测模型相容. 这种限制使系统无法试图检测情感或意图等非视觉概念.

blocks.en: 3.2. CLIP-Variance Guided Multimodal Extraction
blocks.zh: 3.2. CLIP-Variance Guided Multimoduction Inductionon(《国际货物统一分类和标签法》)

blocks.en: This stage selects informative keyframes and extracts multimodal information from the video in parallel.
blocks.zh: 这一阶段选择了信息化的关键框架,并同时从视频中提取多式信息.

blocks.en: Keyframe Selection. A critical challenge in video understanding is selecting which frames to process for detailed analysis. Uniform sampling may miss important moments, while processing all frames is computationally prohibitive. Rather than uniformly sampling frames or relying solely on semantic similarity, inspired by query-guided frame selection in prior work ( Cao et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2024 ) , we propose a CLIP-variance (CV) guided selection mechanism that jointly considers query relevance and visual informativeness. The intuition is that informative frames should both relate to the query content and contain rich visual details rather than static or redundant imagery. For each frame F t F_{t} , we compute a weighted score: (4) s t = sim CLIP ​ ( R det , F t ) ⋅ σ t s_{t}=\text{sim}_{\text{CLIP}}(R_{\text{det}},F_{t})\cdot\sigma_{t} where sim CLIP ​ ( ⋅ ) \text{sim}_{\text{CLIP}}(\cdot) denotes the CLIP similarity between the detection query and frame content. This term ensures that selected frames are semantically relevant to the objects or entities mentioned in the query. The second factor σ t \sigma_{t} is the normalized visual variance of frame F t F_{t} : (5) σ t = Var ​ ( F t ) max j ⁡ Var ​ ( F j ) \sigma_{t}=\frac{\text{Var}(F_{t})}{\max_{j}\text{Var}(F_{j})}
blocks.zh: 键框选择 。 视频理解方面的一个关键挑战是选择进行详细分析的流程框架。 统一取样可能错过重要时刻,而处理所有框架则在计算上令人无法接受。 我们建议采用CLIP-变相(CV)指导性选择机制,联合考虑查询的相关性和视觉信息性。 直觉是,信息框架既应涉及查询内容,也应包含丰富的视觉细节,而不是静态或多余的图像。 对于每个框架 F t F_{t} 我们计算一个加权分数: (4) s t = sim CLIP (R det, F t) \ t s_{t}=\t}=\ttextttextttextttextttextt}_{\ CLIP}} (R_{\ttextttextt}}, F_{t}t}t})\cdot\sigma_{t} 其中 sim CLIP (\)\ text{ sim}\ text{ CLIP{ (\cdot) 表示检测查询和帧内容的 CLIP 相似性 。 此术语确保所选框架与查询中提及的对象或实体具有绝对相关性。 第二个因子是框架 F t F 的正态视觉差异 : (5) \ sigma\t\t\frac\text{瓦尔}(F\t})\max\j\text{瓦尔}(F\\j})}

blocks.en: The variance term captures the visual complexity of each frame, computed from the pixel intensity distribution. Frames with higher variance typically contain more visual structure and details, while low-variance frames often correspond to static backgrounds, black screens, or uniform scenes that provide limited information. By multiplying these two factors, we favor frames that are both query-relevant and visually informative. Keyframes are selected by thresholding on the weighted scores: (6) 𝐅 key = { F t ∣ s t ≥ τ s } \mathbf{F}_{\text{key}}=\{F_{t}\mid s_{t}\geq\tau_{s}\} where τ s \tau_{s} is a score threshold, with constraints on minimum and maximum frame counts to ensure adequate coverage across the video duration.
blocks.zh: 差异名词捕捉到每个帧的视觉复杂性,由像素强度分布来计算. 差异较大的框架通常包含更多的视觉结构和细节,而低变相框架往往对应静态背景,黑幕,或提供有限信息的统一的场景. 通过将这两个因素相乘,我们赞成既与查询相关又具有视觉信息的框架。 通过加权分数阈值来选择关键框架: (6) F 键 = {F t ∣ s≥ s} s}\ mathbf{ F}_{\text{ key }}=\{ F_{t}\mid {\fn黑体\fs22\bord1\shad0\3aHBE\4aH00\fscx67\fscy66\2cHFFFFFF\3cH808080}你觉得呢? 其中\ s\ tau_{s} 是一个分数阈值, 限制最小和最大帧计数, 以确保整个视频期间的充分覆盖。

blocks.en: ASR Extraction. Audio information provides crucial context that is often unavailable through visual analysis alone, including dialogue, narration, and background audio cues. Following recent retrieval-augmented video systems ( Cao et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2024 ) , we extract the audio track from the video and transcribe it using Whisper ( Radford et al., 2023 ) , a robust speech recognition model capable of handling diverse audio conditions. The resulting speech transcripts T asr T_{\text{asr}} are segmented by timestamps to preserve temporal alignment with video frames. These segments are then encoded using Contriever ( Izacard et al., 2021 ) , a dense retrieval encoder trained for semantic similarity matching, producing embeddings that capture the semantic content of each transcript segment. The embeddings are indexed in a FAISS ( Johnson et al., 2019 ) database for efficient similarity search: (7) DB asr ← FAISS 𝐄 asr = Contriever ​ ( T asr ) \text{DB}_{\text{asr}}\xleftarrow{\text{FAISS}}\mathbf{E}_{\text{asr}}=\text{Contriever}(T_{\text{asr}})
blocks.zh: ASR 提取器。 音频信息通过视觉分析,包括对话、叙事和背景音频提示,提供了往往无法提供的重要背景。 继最近检索到的视频系统(Cao等,2025;Luo等,2024)后,我们从视频中取出音频轨迹,并使用Whisper(Radford等,2023)进行翻录,这是一个能处理各种音频条件的强健语音识别模式. 由此而来的语音笔录 T asr T_{\text{asr}}} 被分出时间戳来保持时间与视频帧的对接. 这些片段然后被用Contriever(Izacard等,2021年)来编码,这是一个为语义相似性匹配而训练的密集检索编码器,生成能捕捉到每个语义片段内容的嵌入. 嵌入物在FAISS(Johnson等,2019年)数据库中索引,用于高效的相似性搜索: (7) DB asr QQ FAISS E asr = Contriever (T asr )\text{DB {Asr}}\X leftarrow\text{FAISS {Mathbf{E}_{\text{Asr}}=\text{Contriever} (T_{\text{asr}})

blocks.en: OCR Extraction. On-screen text frequently contains valuable information such as titles, subtitles, labels, and other textual elements that complement visual and audio content. Current LVLMs often struggle to accurately recognize text within video frames, particularly for small or stylized fonts. To address this limitation, we employ EasyOCR ( JaidedAI, 2023 ) , a dedicated text recognition model, to extract on-screen text from each sampled frame. Since OCR models may produce noisy outputs, we apply a confidence threshold to filter low-quality detections: (8) T ocr = { t ∣ t = EasyOCR ( F ) , conf ( t ) > τ ocr } T_{\text{ocr}}=\{t\mid t=\text{EasyOCR}(F),\text{conf}(t)>\tau_{\text{ocr}}\} This filtering step removes unreliable text detections that could introduce noise into the retrieval process. The filtered texts are encoded and stored in a separate FAISS index following the same procedure as ASR: (9) DB ocr ← FAISS 𝐄 ocr = Contriever ​ ( T ocr ) \text{DB}_{\text{ocr}}\xleftarrow{\text{FAISS}}\mathbf{E}_{\text{ocr}}=\text{Contriever}(T_{\text{ocr}})
blocks.zh: OCR 提取器。 屏幕上的文字经常包含一些有价值的信息,例如标题,字幕,标签,以及补充视觉和音频内容的其他文字元素. 当前LVLM经常会挣扎在视频框内准确识别出文本,特别是对小字体或分型字体而言. 为了解决这一限制,我们使用一个专用文本识别模型EasyOCR(JaidedAI,2023年),从每个被抽样的框架提取屏幕上文本. 由于OCR模型可能会产生吵闹的输出,因此我们采用置信阈值来过滤低质量检测: (8) T OCr = {t → t = EasyOCR (F), conf (t) > ocr (t) > T'tttext{ocr}}=\{t\mid t=\text} (F),\text{conf}(t)>\tau_{\text{ocr} 这个过滤步骤会去除不可靠的文本检测,这些检测可能会将噪音引入到检索过程中. 被过滤的文本按照与ASR相同的程序编码并储存在单独的FAISS索引中: (9) DB ocr QQ FAISS E ocr = Contriver (T ocr )\text{DB {ocr}}\X leftarrow\text{FAISS}}\Mathbf{E}_{\text{ocr}}=\text{Contriever} (T_{\text{ocr}})

blocks.en: Object Detection with Scene Graph. While LVLMs demonstrate strong capabilities in object recognition, they continue to face challenges in precise object counting, localization, and understanding spatial relationships between objects. These limitations often lead to hallucinations when answering questions that require fine-grained visual understanding. To provide more accurate object-level information, we employ APE ( Shen et al., 2024 ) , an open-vocabulary object detection model that accepts textual prompts specifying which objects to detect. For the selected keyframes 𝐅 key \mathbf{F}_{\text{key}} , APE localizes relevant objects based on the detection request: (10) D t = APE ​ ( F t , R det ) , F t ∈ 𝐅 key D_{t}=\text{APE}(F_{t},R_{\text{det}}),\quad F_{t}\in\mathbf{F}_{\text{key}}
blocks.zh: 用场景图进行对象检测 。 虽然LVLMs在物体识别方面表现出了强大的能力,但它们在精确的物体计数,局部化,以及理解物体之间的空间关系方面仍然面临挑战. 这些局限性在回答需要精细视觉理解的问题时,往往会导致幻觉. 为了提供更准确的物体级信息,我们采用了APE(Shen等,2024年),即一个可接受文字提示的开放式物体检测模型,指定哪些物体可以被检测. 对于所选的密钥框架 F 密钥\ mathbf{ F}_{\text{ key}, APE 根据检测请求将相关对象本地化 : (10) D t = APE (F t, R det), Ft∈t}=\t}=\text{ APE} (F_{t}, R_{\text{ det}}),\quad F_{t}\in\ mathbf{ F}_{\text{ key}}} (中文(简体) ).

blocks.en: The raw detection outputs consisting of object categories and bounding box coordinates are not directly interpretable by language models. To bridge this gap, inspired by scene graph representations in visual reasoning ( Cao et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2024 ) , we transform the detection results into semantic scene graph descriptions expressed in natural language. For each keyframe, we generate three complementary types of information: (1) Object Location A loc A_{\text{loc}} converts bounding box coordinates into natural language spatial descriptions (e.g., “left side of frame”, “upper right corner”), making positional information accessible to the language model; (2) Object Count A cnt A_{\text{cnt}} aggregates detection results to provide accurate counts for each object category, addressing the counting limitations of LVLMs; (3) Object Relation A rel A_{\text{rel}} computes and describes relative spatial relationships between detected objects (e.g., “person A is to the left of person B”). The complete scene graph representation combines these components:

blocks.en: 3.3. Temporal Event Chain Construction
blocks.zh: 3.3. 临时事件链建设

blocks.en: Unlike frame-level retrieval methods that treat video as a collection of independent images, EC-RAG explicitly models the temporal structure of video content by constructing an event chain. This representation captures how events unfold over time and enables reasoning about temporal relationships.
blocks.zh: 与将视频作为独立图像集合的帧级检索方法不同,EC-RAG通过构建事件链来明确模拟视频内容的时间结构. 这种表述可以捕捉事件随着时间的流逝而发展,并能够对时间关系进行推理.

blocks.en: Video Segmentation. Long videos contain extended sequences of content that cannot be processed as a single unit. We partition the video into non-overlapping temporal segments of fixed duration Δ \Delta : (12) 𝒮 = { S i = [ t i , t i + Δ ) ∣ i = 0 , 1 , … , ⌊ L / Δ ⌋ } \mathcal{S}=\{S_{i}=[t_{i},t_{i}+\Delta)\mid i=0,1,\ldots,\lfloor L/\Delta\rfloor\} where L L is the total video duration. Each segment S i S_{i} serves as the basic unit for event extraction and is associated with the multimodal information (ASR, OCR, DET) extracted from frames within its time range. This segmentation balances granularity and efficiency: segments should be short enough to capture coherent events while being long enough to contain meaningful content.

Event Extraction. Raw multimodal data from each segment needs to be synthesized into a coherent semantic representation. For each segment S i S_{i} , we aggregate the corresponding ASR, OCR, and DET information and prompt the LVLM to extract a semantic event description that summarizes what happens in that temporal window: (13) e i = LVLM ​ ( P e , T asr ( i ) , T ocr ( i ) , T det ( i ) ) e_{i}=\text{LVLM}(P_{e},T_{\text{asr}}^{(i)},T_{\text{ocr}}^{(i)},T_{\text{det}}^{(i)}) where P e P_{e} is the event extraction prompt that instructs the model to integrate information across modalities. The prompt guides the LVLM to focus on the main action or occurrence while considering all available evidence. Each extracted event e i e_{i} comprises three components: a description that concisely summarizes what happens in this segment by integrating speech, text, and visual information; a type that classifies the event as action, dialogue, scene transition, or informational content; and a list of participants identifying key entities (people, objects) involved in the event.
blocks.zh: 事件提取。 需要将每个部分的原始多式数据综合成一个连贯的语义表述。 对于每段S i S_{i},我们汇总相应的ASR,OCR,和DET信息,并促使LVLM提取一个语义事件描述来总结该时间窗口中发生的事情: (13) e i = LVLM (P e, T asr (一), T ocr (一), T det (一)) . e_{i}=\text{LVLM} (P_{e}, T_{\text{asr}}^{(一)}, T_{\text{ocr}}^{(一)}, T_{\text{det}}^{(一)} 其中 P ee}e} 是事件提取提示,指示模型将信息整合到不同模式中去. 该提示指导LVLM在考虑所有现有证据的同时,注重主要行动或发生. 每个提取出的事件e i e_{i}由三个部分组成:一个通过综合语音,文字,和视觉信息简洁地概括本段发生的事情的描述;一个将事件分类为动作,对话,场景过渡,或信息内容的类型;以及一个参与者名单,确定参与事件的关键实体(人物,对象).

blocks.en: Event Chain Assembly. Individual events are connected to form a coherent narrative structure. The extracted events are organized into a temporal event chain ℰ = { e 0 , e 1 , … , e n } \mathcal{E}=\{e_{0},e_{1},\ldots,e_{n}\} with explicit temporal ordering that reflects the video’s chronological structure. We establish predecessor-successor relations between adjacent events: (14) e i → temporal e i + 1 , ∀ i ∈ [ 0 , n − 1 ] e_{i}\xrightarrow{\text{temporal}}e_{i+1},\quad\forall i\in[0,n-1]

blocks.en: The complete event chain provides a structured overview of the video’s narrative progression, capturing how events unfold and connect across time. This representation enables the model to understand not just individual moments but also the broader context and temporal dynamics of the video content.
blocks.zh: 完整事件链提供了视频叙事进展的有条理的概述,捕捉出事件如何展开并相互连接。 这种表述使模型不仅能够了解个别时刻,而且能够了解视频内容的更广泛的背景和时间动态。

blocks.en: 3.4. Evidence-augmented Multimodal Reasoning
blocks.zh: 3.4. 证据证明的多式联运理由

blocks.en: With the event chain constructed, EC-RAG performs query-guided retrieval to identify relevant events and gather supporting evidence for answer generation.
blocks.zh: 随着事件链的构建,EC-RAG进行有查询指导的检索,以识别相关事件并收集辅助证据生成答案.

blocks.en: Query-guided Event Localization. Not all events in a video are relevant to a given query. We identify the most relevant events through semantic similarity matching between the query and event descriptions. Each event description is encoded using Contriever and compared against the query embedding using cosine similarity: (15) sim i = cos ( Contriever ( Q ) , Contriever ( e i . desc ) ) \text{sim}_{i}=\cos\bigl(\text{Contriever}(Q),\;\text{Contriever}(e_{i}.\text{desc})\bigr)
blocks.zh: 查询指导事件本地化. 并非所有视频中的事件都与给定的查询相关. 我们通过语义上对查询和事件描述的相匹配来识别最相关的事件. 每个事件描述都使用 Contriever 编码,并与使用 cosine 相似性嵌入的查询进行对比 : (15) sim i = cos (Contriever (Q), Contriever (e. i. desc))\text{sim}_{i}=\cos\ bigl (\text{Contriever} (Q),\;\text{Contriever}(e_{i}.\text{desc}\bigr)

blocks.en: This text-to-text matching is more appropriate than image-text matching (e.g., CLIP) since both the query and event descriptions are textual. Events exceeding a relevance threshold τ loc \tau_{\text{loc}} are selected as located events: (16) ℰ loc = { e i ∣ sim i > τ loc } \mathcal{E}_{\text{loc}}=\{e_{i}\mid\text{sim}_{i}>\tau_{\text{loc}}\}
blocks.zh: 这种从文字到文字的匹配比从图像到文字的匹配(例如CLIP)更合适,因为查询和事件描述都是文字上的. 超过关联阈值的事件被选为位置事件 : (16) E loc = { e ∣ sim i >\ mathcal{ E }_{\text{loc}}=\{e_{i}\i}\mid\text{sim}_{i}>\tautautext{loc}}\}}

blocks.en: The located events represent the temporal regions most likely to contain information needed to answer the query.
blocks.zh: 定位事件代表最可能包含回答询问所需信息的时间区域。

blocks.en: Evidence Retrieval. While event descriptions provide high-level summaries, detailed evidence from the original multimodal sources may be necessary for accurate reasoning. For each located event e i ∈ ℰ loc e_{i}\in\mathcal{E}_{\text{loc}} , we retrieve the associated multimodal evidence from the constructed databases. Using the retrieval requests 𝐑 \mathbf{R} generated during query decoupling, we query the ASR and OCR databases to obtain relevant text segments: (17) A asr = Retrieve ​ ( DB asr , R asr , τ ) , A ocr = Retrieve ​ ( DB ocr , R ocr , τ ) A_{\text{asr}}=\text{Retrieve}(\text{DB}_{\text{asr}},R_{\text{asr}},\tau),\quad A_{\text{ocr}}=\text{Retrieve}(\text{DB}_{\text{ocr}},R_{\text{ocr}},\tau) The DET evidence is collected from the scene graphs of keyframes falling within the located events’ time ranges: (18) A det = { T det ( t ) ∣ F t ∈ 𝐅 key , t ∈ e i . span , e i ∈ ℰ loc } A_{\text{det}}=\{T_{\text{det}}^{(t)}\mid F_{t}\in\mathbf{F}_{\text{key}},\;t\in e_{i}.\text{span},\;e_{i}\in\mathcal{E}_{\text{loc}}\} where the retrieval function returns all database entries with similarity scores exceeding threshold τ \tau . The DET evidence A det A_{\text{det}} is directly obtained from the scene graph descriptions of keyframes within the located events’ time ranges, providing detailed object-level information for visual grounding.

The context combines three complementary components: (1) Event Chain Summary provides a global overview of all events in the video, giving the model awareness of the full narrative arc even for content not directly relevant to the query; (2) Located Events contain detailed descriptions of query-relevant events along with their temporal predecessors, enabling understanding of causal relationships and temporal context; (3) Multimodal Evidence includes the raw ASR, OCR, and DET information retrieved for the located events, providing specific details that support accurate reasoning. The complete context is assembled as: (19) C = Concat ​ ( Summary ​ ( ℰ ) , Detail ​ ( ℰ loc ) , A asr , A ocr , A det ) C=\text{Concat}(\text{Summary}(\mathcal{E}),\text{Detail}(\mathcal{E}_{\text{loc}}),A_{\text{asr}},A_{\text{ocr}},A_{\text{det}})

blocks.en: 4. Experiments
blocks.zh: 4. 实验

blocks.en: 4.1. Datasets
blocks.zh: 4.1. 数据集

blocks.en: We assess EC-RAG on three widely adopted long-video benchmarks that span diverse durations, domains, and reasoning demands.
blocks.zh: 我们根据三个广泛采用的长视频基准评估欧共体区域专家组,这些基准跨越不同的期限、领域和推理要求。

blocks.en:
Video-MME ( Fu et al., 2025 ) offers a systematic testbed for evaluating multimodal comprehension over real-world video content.
Its 900 videos are grouped by length into short ( < < 2 min), medium (4–15 min), and long (30–60 min) subsets, yielding 2,700 multiple-choice questions across 12 task types—ranging from object recognition and counting to temporal reasoning and OCR—and 30 sub-categories drawn from six broad domains including knowledge, sports, and film.
This breadth makes Video-MME particularly suitable for stress-testing whether a retrieval-augmented pipeline can supply the right modality of evidence for each question type.
blocks.zh:
Video-MME(Fu等人,2025年)提供了一个系统测试台,用于评价对现实世界视频内容的多式联运理解。
它的900个视频按长度分为短( < 2 min)、中(4至15分钟)和长(30至60分钟)子集,在12个任务类型中产生2 700个多重选择问题——从物体识别和计数到时间推理和OCR——以及从知识、体育和电影等6个广泛领域抽取的30个子类。
这种宽度使得Video-MME特别适合测试一个取回式管道是否能够为每个问题类型提供正确的证据方式。

blocks.en: MLVU ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) assembles nine evaluation tasks from videos of 3 min to 2 h (mean ≈ \approx 12 min), requiring models to sustain reasoning over extended temporal ranges
blocks.zh: MLVU(周来等,2024年)从3分到2分的视频组装出9个评价任务(平均QQ\约12分),需要模型在延长的时间范围内维持推理.

blocks.en:
LongVideoBench ( Wu et al., 2024 ) focuses on multimodal retrieval and compositional reasoning within lengthy footage.
It provides 6,678 human-written multiple-choice questions spanning 17 thematic categories, testing a model’s ability to pinpoint and integrate evidence scattered across long video timelines.
blocks.zh:
Long Video Bench(Wu等,2024年)侧重于长片中多式检索和组成推理.
它提供6 678个人写多选择问题,涉及17个主题类别,测试一个模型确定和综合分散在长视频时间段的证据的能力。

blocks.en: 4.2. Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.2. 实施细节

blocks.en:
All experiments were conducted on NVIDIA RTX 4090 and A800 80 GB GPUs.
We adopt LLaVA-Video-7B ( Zhang et al., 2024e ) as the primary LVLM backbone, with three additional 7B architectures and the 72B variant evaluated in Table 1 to verify cross-architecture and cross-scale generalizability.
Detection requests produced during query decoupling are post-filtered with spaCy to retain only concrete, CLIP-responsive entities.
Both the CLIP similarity threshold and the FAISS ( Johnson et al., 2019 ) retrieval threshold are fixed at τ = 0.3 \tau=0.3 , with IndexFlatIP as the similarity backend.
Videos are segmented into 30-second windows for event chain construction.
Speech is transcribed by Whisper-Large ( Radford et al., 2023 ) , on-screen text is recognized by EasyOCR ( JaidedAI, 2023 ) , open-vocabulary detection is handled by APE ( Shen et al., 2024 ) , and dense text retrieval is performed by Contriever ( Izacard et al., 2021 ) .
Our ablation suite is built around LLaVA-Video-7B at 32 frames, whose moderate context window makes it a practical testbed for probing the effect of individual components and hyper-parameters.
blocks.zh:
所有实验都是在NVIDIA RTX 4090和A800 80GB GPU上进行的.
我们采用LLaVA-Video-7B(Zhang等,2024e)作为LVLM主干,另外三个7B建筑和72B变体在表1中被评价,以验证跨建筑和跨尺度可通用性.
查询解接过程中生成的检测请求在过滤后与温泉区连接 Cy只保留具体,CLIP反应的实体.
CLIP相似性阈值和FAISS(Johnson等,2019年)的取回阈值均被固定为\\tau=0.3,以IndexFlatIP为相似性后端.
视频被分入30秒窗口,用于事件链构建.
语音由Whisper-Large(Radford等,2023年)转写,屏幕上文字由EasyOCR(JaidedAI,2023年)确认,开口-vobulary检测由APE(Shen等,2024年)处理,密集文本检索由Contriever(Izacard等,2021年)进行.
我们的乳房套间以32帧的LLaVA-Video-7B为中心建造,其温和上下文窗口使它成为检验单个组件和超参数效果的实用试验台.

blocks.en: Video-MME. To verify that EC-RAG generalizes across architectures, model scales, and frame budgets, we integrate it into four open-source LVLMs spanning 8–32 input frames, as reported in Table 1 . EC-RAG yields consistent improvements for every backbone, with gains most pronounced on long videos where uniform sampling alone cannot cover the query-relevant content. The benefit is especially evident on frame-constrained backbones, confirming that event-chain retrieval compensates effectively for sparse visual input. The pipeline injects approximately 2 K tokens of supplementary textual context (the #Text column), comparable to roughly 14 extra keyframes in payload, which complement the visual input and help anchor temporal reasoning.
blocks.zh: 视频-MME. 为了核实EC-RAG对架构、模型规模和框架预算的概括,我们把它融入了表1所报的跨越8-32个输入框架的四个开源LVLM。 欧盟委员会区域专家组对每个主干网都取得了一致的改进,在长相视频上收获最多,仅靠统一取样无法覆盖与查询有关的内容。 这一好处在受帧制约的骨干上尤其明显,证实事件链检索有效补偿了视觉输入的稀少. 管道注入了大约2K个补充文字上下文(#Text一栏)的符号,相当于有效载荷中大约14个额外的键框,它们补充了视觉输入,帮助锁定时间推理.

blocks.en: Scaling to the 72B LLaVA-Video, EC-RAG achieves 75.7% overall, surpassing both GPT-4o ( OpenAI, 2024 ) and Gemini-1.5-Pro ( Team et al., 2024 ) , showing that structured event-chain retrieval enables open-source models to outperform proprietary systems without additional pretraining. EC-RAG also consistently outperforms Video-RAG ( Luo et al., 2024 ) and TV-RAG ( Cao et al., 2025 ) under the same backbone setting, as event-level temporal localization provides more precise context than frame-level retrieval.
blocks.zh: 扩大至72B LLaVA-Video, EC-RAG总体实现75.7%,超过了GPT-4o(OpenAI, 2024年)和双子座1.5-Pro(Team等, 2024年),表明结构化的事件链检索使得开源模型能够超越专利系统,而无需额外的预训. EC-RAG在相同的骨干结构下也一贯优于Video-RAG(Luo等,2024年)和TV-RAG(Cao等,2025年),因为事件时间定位比帧级检索提供了更精确的背景.

MLVU. Table 2 reports performance on the MLVU multiple-choice task.
EC-RAG lifts LLaVA-Video-7B from 70.8 to 72.9 , outperforming both Video-RAG and TV-RAG on the same backbone.
Notably, this 7B model with only 64 frames also surpasses Oryx-1.5 ( Liu et al., 2024b ) , a 32B model operating on 128 frames, highlighting the efficiency of event-chain retrieval over brute-force scaling.
blocks.zh:
玛文。 表2汇报了劳动和社会保障部多重选择任务的执行情况。
EC-RAG将LLaVA-Video-7B从70.8提升到72.9,在同一个主干线上比Video-RAG和TV-RAG都表现优异.

blocks.en:
LongVideoBench. As shown in Table 3 , EC-RAG also achieves the best result on LongVideoBench, reaching 59.5 with LLaVA-Video-7B at 64 frames.
This benchmark requires retrieving and composing evidence distributed across long timelines, a scenario that directly benefits from EC-RAG’s temporal event chain design.
Compared with Video-RAG and TV-RAG under the same setting, EC-RAG provides a more substantial boost over the unaugmented baseline, indicating that event-level localization is more effective than flat retrieval when evidence is temporally scattered.

这一基准要求检索和收集跨长时限分发的证据,这种假设情景直接受益于欧共体区域专家组的时间事件链设计。
与同一背景下的Video-RAG和TV-RAG相比,EC-RAG比未强化基线提供了更大幅度的推动,表明当证据暂时分散时,事件一级本地化比平面检索更有效.

blocks.en: Figure 4. Qualitative comparison between the baseline LLaVA-Video and EC-RAG on a Video-MME example. The baseline confuses temporally distinct segments, whereas EC-RAG localizes the query-relevant event through its event chain and aggregates ASR and DET evidence to arrive at the correct answer. A qualitative case study showing how EC-RAG correctly answers a temporal reasoning question by localizing the relevant event and aggregating multimodal evidence.
blocks.zh: 图 4. 将LLaVA-Video基线与EC-RAG以视频-MME为例进行定性比较。 基线混淆了时间上不同的部分,而EC-RAG通过其事件链将与查询相关的事件本地化,并汇总ASR和DET的证据以得出正确的答案. 一项定性案例研究表明,欧共体区域专家组如何通过将相关事件本地化和汇总多式联运证据正确回答一个时间推理问题。

blocks.en:
To quantify each component’s contribution, we ablate EC-RAG on Video-MME with LLaVA-Video-7B at 32 frames (Table 4 ).
Among all modules, ASR has the greatest impact: removing it causes the most significant performance degradation, particularly on medium and long videos, confirming that speech transcription is the most informative auxiliary modality for video QA.
The event chain module ranks second in importance, as disabling temporal localization leads to less targeted evidence retrieval.
CLIP-variance guided keyframe selection, OCR, and DET each provide meaningful but comparatively smaller gains, reflecting their complementary roles in selecting informative frames, capturing on-screen text, and grounding physical entities respectively.
blocks.zh:
为了量化每个组成部分的贡献,我们将视频-MME上的EC-RAG与LLaVA-Video-7B放在32个框架(表4)上。
在所有模块中,ASR的影响最大:去除它会导致最显著的性能退化,特别是在中长视频上,证实语音转录是视频QA中信息最丰富的辅助模式.
事件链模块在重要性上排在第二位,因为使时间本地化失效导致证据检索目标较少。
CLIP变异制指导关键框架的选择、OCR和DET各自提供了有意义的但相对较少的收益,反映了它们在选择信息框架、获取屏幕文本和地面实体方面的互补作用。

blocks.en: 4.4. Qualitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.4. 定性分析

blocks.en:
Figure 4 presents a representative case from Video-MME in which the baseline LLaVA-Video fails but EC-RAG succeeds.
The question asks what happened in the car after the heroine returned from shopping.
With 32 uniformly sampled frames, the baseline captures a frame showing the baby in a cheerful state and, lacking any temporal context to disambiguate it from other segments, incorrectly selects option C (“Baby happy”).
blocks.zh:
图4介绍了Video-MME的一个代表性案例,其中LLaVA-Video基线失败,但EC-RAG成功。
问起女主角从购物回来后在车上发生了什么.
基线用32个统一取样的帧来捕捉一个显示婴儿处于欢快状态的帧,并且由于没有任何时间上下文可以将其从其他段分解出来,因此错误地选择了选项C(“婴儿快乐”)。

blocks.en:
EC-RAG addresses this through its pipeline: the query decoupling stage extracts modality-specific retrieval cues (e.g., ASR keywords “car, shopping, unhappy” and DET targets “baby, car seat”).
The event chain then localizes the relevant temporal segment, whose ASR transcript explicitly states “He was just not happy in the car.”
Simultaneously, CLIP-variance guided keyframe selection identifies a visually informative frame that is forwarded to the object detector, revealing a baby being fed with a recently-cried expression.
Equipped with this temporally grounded multimodal evidence, the model correctly selects option D (“Baby unhappy”).
blocks.zh:
EC-RAG通过它的管道解决了这个问题:查询脱钩阶段提取出特定模式的检索提示(例如ASR关键词"汽车,购物,不愉快"和DET目标"婴儿,车座"等).
事件链将相关时间段本地化,ASR记录中明确指出“他只是不高兴。 “
同时,CLIP-变异制导键框选择确定一个可视化信息框架,并传递给物体探测器,揭示一个婴儿被喂入最近试验过的表情.
与这种基于时间的多模式证据相一致,模型正确地选择了备选案文D(“婴儿不满意”)。

blocks.en:
Figure 3 further illustrates the effect of EC-RAG through Grad-CAM heatmaps and t-SNE projections.
The Grad-CAM visualizations compare the attention distribution of the baseline and EC-RAG on both a query-relevant and a query-irrelevant frame.
With the supplementary textual evidence provided by EC-RAG, the model’s attention concentrates more tightly on the semantically relevant regions (e.g., the baby and car seat), whereas the baseline distributes attention more diffusely.
The t-SNE plot projects the query, vision, and text features into a shared 2D space, showing that EC-RAG’s auxiliary tokens pull the vision and query representations closer together, resulting in more aligned cross-modal features that facilitate accurate reasoning.
blocks.zh:
图3进一步说明了EC-RAG通过Grad-CAM热图和t-SNE预测的影响。
Grad-CAM可视化比较基线和EC-RAG在与查询相关的框架和与查询相关的框架上的注意力分布.
由于欧洲反垄断集团提供了补充文字证据,该模型的注意力更集中到与它有关的区域(例如婴儿和汽车座椅),而基线则更分散地分配注意力。
t-SNE版图将查询,视觉,文本等功能投放到共享的2D空间中,显示EC-RAG的辅助符使视觉和查询表达更加接近,从而形成了更趋一致的交叉模式特征来方便准确推理.

blocks.en: 5. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 (韩语). 结论

blocks.en: We presented EC-RAG, a training-free retrieval-augmented generation framework that structures long-video understanding around temporal event chains. By decomposing videos into semantically coherent events through the fusion of ASR, OCR, and open-vocabulary detection, and localizing query-relevant segments before injecting multimodal evidence into the LVLM prompt, EC-RAG consistently improves diverse backbones across three benchmarks—Video-MME, MLVU, and LongVideoBench—outperforming existing RAG-based methods under every tested setting. Notably, with the 72B LLaVA-Video backbone, EC-RAG surpasses both GPT-4o and Gemini-1.5-Pro on Video-MME using a fully open-source pipeline, demonstrating that structured event-level retrieval enables open-source models to rival and even surpass proprietary systems without additional training.

blocks.en: Beyond the benchmarks evaluated in this work, we believe the event-chain paradigm holds broader potential for other video-centric tasks such as video summarization, temporal grounding, and multi-turn video dialogue, where preserving temporal structure and aggregating cross-modal evidence are equally critical. The training-free nature of EC-RAG also makes it readily applicable to emerging LVLMs as they continue to evolve, offering a flexible and scalable augmentation strategy.
blocks.zh: 除了这项工作所评估的基准外,我们认为,事件链模式对于其他以视频为中心的任务具有更广泛的潜力,例如视频汇总、时间定位和多回合视频对话,在这些方面,保留时间结构和汇集跨模式证据同样重要。 欧共体区域反洗钱小组的无培训性质也使得它能够随时适用于不断演变的LVLM,提供了灵活而可扩展的增强战略。

Frame Sampling Budget. We investigate the sensitivity of EC-RAG to the number of sampled frames by evaluating LLaVA-Video-7B ( Zhang et al., 2024e ) under three frame budgets: 8, 16, and 32 on Video-MME ( Fu et al., 2025 ) .
As shown in Figure 5 , EC-RAG consistently outperforms the baseline at every frame budget across all duration categories.
Notably, the baseline shows diminishing returns as the frame count increases—particularly on long videos, where doubling from 16 to 32 frames yields only marginal improvement, suggesting that simply adding more visual input cannot compensate for the lack of temporal and textual context.
In contrast, EC-RAG maintains substantial gains at all budgets, with the largest absolute improvement observed at 16 frames, indicating that event-chain retrieval is especially effective when the visual input is moderately sparse and the model most needs supplementary evidence to bridge temporal gaps.

blocks.en: Retrieval Threshold. Table 5 investigates the effect of the retrieval similarity threshold τ \tau on both efficiency and accuracy. Lower thresholds ( τ = 0.0 \tau{=}0.0 – 0.1 0.1 ) retain nearly all retrieved text, injecting up to 4.4 K supplementary tokens and pushing inference time to over 46 s per question, yet only achieve 64.1–64.7% overall. As τ \tau increases, the token budget and latency decrease steadily; at τ = 0.3 \tau{=}0.3 , EC-RAG processes 2.4 K tokens in 18 s while reaching the peak overall accuracy of 65.1%, with the best short-video (73.4%) and long-video (61.2%) scores. This non-monotonic pattern indicates that unfiltered retrieval introduces noisy evidence that can mislead the model. Beyond τ = 0.3 \tau{=}0.3 , accuracy degrades as useful context is progressively pruned: τ = 0.5 \tau{=}0.5 drops to 60.8% and τ = 1.0 \tau{=}1.0 —which effectively discards all retrieved text (0.0 K tokens)—falls to 58.9%. We therefore adopt τ = 0.3 \tau{=}0.3 as the default, which reduces latency by roughly 65% compared to unfiltered retrieval while maximizing accuracy.

blocks.en: Cross-Backbone RAG Comparison. Table 6 compares EC-RAG with Video-RAG ( Luo et al., 2024 ) and TV-RAG ( Cao et al., 2025 ) under two additional backbone settings. On Video-LLaVA-7B ( Lin et al., 2024a ) with 8 frames, all three RAG methods substantially improve over the baseline (39.6%), with EC-RAG achieving the highest overall accuracy of 46.0%, outperforming TV-RAG by +0.5 and Video-RAG by +1.0. The advantage is most pronounced on long videos (+0.8 over TV-RAG), where event-chain retrieval provides more temporally precise context than frame-level or segment-level approaches. On LongVA-7B ( Zhang et al., 2024b ) with 32 frames, the same trend holds: EC-RAG reaches 62.8% overall, surpassing TV-RAG (61.7%) and Video-RAG (60.1%). EC-RAG consistently leads across all duration categories under both backbones, confirming that structured event-level retrieval generalizes across different LVLMs and frame budgets.

blocks.en: Table 7 presents a fine-grained breakdown of accuracy across all 12 task types on Video-MME under 8-frame and 16-frame settings. With 8 frames, EC-RAG improves the average by +5.6 points (54.6% → \to 60.2%), with the largest gains on Information Synopsis (+9.6), Spatial Reasoning (+9.0), and OCR (+7.9)—tasks that heavily rely on textual or spatial cues where event-chain evidence provides direct support. At 16 frames, the average gain further widens to +7.8 points (58.0% → \to 65.8%), with Action Reasoning seeing the most dramatic improvement (+13.7) followed by Attribute Perception (+10.4) and Information Synopsis (+9.9). EC-RAG achieves the best score on 10 out of 12 task types at 8 frames and 12 out of 12 at 16 frames, demonstrating that the event-chain retrieval complements visual features comprehensively across diverse question types rather than benefiting only a narrow subset.

blocks.en: We present additional qualitative results of LLaVA-Video-7B ( Zhang et al., 2024e ) with EC-RAG on two representative examples from Video-MME ( Fu et al., 2025 ) in Figures 6 and 7 . Both cases involve temporal reasoning questions from long documentary videos, where the baseline model fails due to the inherent ambiguity of sparsely sampled frames. As illustrated, by constructing temporal event chains from multimodal evidence—particularly ASR transcripts that capture the chronological progression of topics and events—EC-RAG enables the model to accurately resolve temporal ordering and causal relationships that are indistinguishable from visual information alone. The results demonstrate that event-level retrieval effectively bridges the gap between sparse visual sampling and the dense temporal reasoning required for long video understanding.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了LLaVA-Video-7B(Zhang等人,2024年e)和EC-RAG关于Video-MME(Fu等人,2025年)的两个代表性例子在图6和图7中的额外质量结果。 这两个案例都涉及到从长长的文献录相带中得出的时间推理问题,其中基准模型由于被采样的帧固有的模糊性而失败. 正如所说明的,通过从多式联运证据中构建时间事件链——特别是反映专题和事件按时间顺序进展的ASR记录稿——欧洲区域专家组使模型能够准确地解决时间顺序和因果关系,而这种关系仅与视觉信息是无法区分的。 结果显示,事件级检索有效弥合了短视采样与长视频理解所需的密集时间推理之间的差距.
